name: coscientist
description: Academic-research-agent toolkit: deep-research pipeline + 70 skills + 43 personas + observability stack

consensus_authed.title: Consensus Pro account linked
consensus_authed.description: Set true if you've completed Consensus OAuth via mcp-remote (https://docs.consensus.app/docs/mcp). Bumps result budget from 3 to 20 per query.

consensus_api_key.title: Consensus API key (Enterprise tier only)
consensus_api_key.description: Static bearer token. Pro tier uses OAuth instead — leave empty.

zenodo_token.title: Zenodo deposit token
zenodo_token.description: API token for dataset DOI minting (zenodo-deposit skill). Get one at https://zenodo.org/account/settings/applications/.

zotero_api_host.title: Zotero local API URL
zotero_api_host.description: Default 127.0.0.1:23119 works for local Zotero with the better-bibtex extension.

publisher_delay_seconds.title: Per-publisher rate-limit delay (seconds)
publisher_delay_seconds.description: Time between paper-acquire fetches to the same publisher domain.
